# Sampath Kumar | AI & Cloud Blog

> Personal blog of M Sampath Kumar — Senior Developer Programs Engineer at
> Google Cloud. Long-form writing and cookbooks on AI agents, the Google Agent
> Development Kit (ADK), the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol, Gemini, Google
> Cloud, and adjacent developer topics; plus a record of talks and events.

The site is built with MkDocs-Material. All content is authored as plain
Markdown and published to GitHub Pages. There is no login wall, no paid
content, and no dynamic rendering — every URL below returns static HTML and
the underlying `.md` source is deterministic.

## Cookbook

Step-by-step technical tutorials with runnable code.

- [Cookbook — Hub](https://msampathkumar.github.io/cookbook/): Landing page for all cookbooks (Gemini now; A2A coming soon).
- [Gemini Cookbook — Overview](https://msampathkumar.github.io/google-cloud-gemini-cookbook/): Index of the five-lesson Gemini + Google Cloud cookbook series.
- [Lesson 1 — Basic Chatbot with Streamlit](https://msampathkumar.github.io/google-cloud-gemini-cookbook/lesson-01/): Build a minimal Gemini chatbot with a Streamlit UI.
- [Lesson 2 — Chatbot with Memory & Gemma](https://msampathkumar.github.io/google-cloud-gemini-cookbook/lesson-02/): Add conversational memory; introduce Gemma as an alternative model.
- [Lesson 3 — Multimodality with Vision](https://msampathkumar.github.io/google-cloud-gemini-cookbook/lesson-03/): Extend the chatbot to accept images and reason over them.
- [Lesson 4 — Knowledge Base Q&A with RAG](https://msampathkumar.github.io/google-cloud-gemini-cookbook/lesson-04/): Retrieval-Augmented Generation over a local knowledge base.
- [Lesson 5 — Advanced RAG with Knowledge Graphs](https://msampathkumar.github.io/google-cloud-gemini-cookbook/lesson-05/): Extend RAG with knowledge-graph structure for richer retrieval.

## Writing — Agent-to-Agent (A2A)

Deep dives on the A2A protocol: what it is, what's new, and how to run it in production.

- [Docker for Agents: A Backend Engineer's Introduction to A2A](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/a2a/intro/): A2A as a lightweight wrapper (like Docker) that makes any agent interoperable.
- [What's New in A2A: v1.0, a Python DX Glow-Up, and a Fresh New Look](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/a2a/v1-release/): The A2A v1.0 release, Python developer experience, and docs refresh.
- [A2A Joins AAIF](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/a2a/a2a-joins-aaif/): Acceptance into the Linux Foundation-directed AAIF as a Growth Stage project.
- [Three Agents Behind One Door: Multi-Tenancy in A2A](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/a2a/multi-tenancy/): Three patterns for scaling agentic apps with A2A multi-tenancy.
- [Breaking Down Agent Silos: The A2A Integration Test Kit Dashboard](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/a2a/test-kit/): Cross-framework interoperability testing for A2A.
- [Introducing the Whitepaper on Building Secure Multi-Agent Frameworks on Google Cloud](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/a2a/security-whitepaper/): Enterprise-ready, secure multi-agent architecture.

## Writing — Google Cloud Next 2026 series

Five-part recap and analysis of Google Cloud Next 2026 announcements.

- [Part 1 — Intro & Next-Gen Infrastructure](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/cloud-next-2026/infrastructure/): The agentic cloud infrastructure story.
- [Part 2 — GAP & Foundational Models](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/cloud-next-2026/foundational-models/): Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform and the foundational model lineup.
- [Part 3 — Developer Tools & MCP Servers](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/cloud-next-2026/dev-tools-mcp-servers/): Developer tooling and the role of Model Context Protocol.
- [Part 4 — Data Cloud, Protocols & Security](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/cloud-next-2026/data-protocols-security/): Data-cloud updates plus the agent-protocol and security stories.
- [Part 5 — Workspace Reimagined & AI Agents](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/cloud-next-2026/workspace-ai-agents/): Workspace + AI-agent integration.

## Writing — Technical articles

Long-form analysis of agent architectures, protocols, and developer practice.

- [Building an Agentic Sandbox: Provisioning a Google Cloud VM Workstation](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/technical/building-agentic-sandbox-vm/): How to configure an isolated Compute Engine VM as a personal sandbox and secondary workstation for running Agentic AI harnesses, Gemini, and Vertex AI experiments.
- [Setting Up GUI & Chrome Remote Desktop on a Google Cloud VM](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/technical/setup-gui-chrome-remote-desktop-gcp-vm/): How to configure a lightweight XFCE desktop environment and Chrome Remote Desktop on a Google Cloud Compute Engine VM for browser-based remote access.
- [Mastering tmux: Headless Sessions & Automation](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/technical/mastering-tmux/): How tmux headless sessions, session resurrection, and automation empower persistent developer workflows.
- [5 Science-Backed Takeaways to Improve Your Multi-Agentic Systems](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/technical/science-backed-multi-agent-takeaways/): Empirical findings from 180 multi-agent configurations on scalability, coordination trade-offs, and architecture design.
- [The Beads Memory System: Technical Architecture and Integration with Gemini CLI](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/technical/beads-memory-system/): Architecture breakdown of the Beads memory system, SQLite + JSONL hybrid storage, and Gemini CLI MCP integration.
- [The Role of Python in Google Cloud](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/technical/python-in-google-cloud/): Why Python remains the lingua franca for cloud + AI on Google Cloud.
- [Advanced Memory Management for Agentic AI Development](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/technical/memory-management-agentic-ai/): Patterns for short-term, long-term, and shared memory in agent systems.
- [The Quantum Leap in AI: Faster, Greener, and More Powerful](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/technical/quantum-ai-era/): Exploring the synergies between quantum computing and AI.
- [Context-Driven Development with Conductor for Gemini CLI](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/technical/conductor-gemini-cli/): Learn how to give Gemini CLI the full context of your project with Conductor and Context-Driven Development (CDD).
- [Documentation-Driven Development (D3) in the AI Era](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/technical/documentation-driven-development/): Why documentation is becoming the primary driver for software development in the age of LLMs, Agents, and Vibe Coding.
- [Vibe Coding: What It Is, When to Use It, and When to Hit the Brakes](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/technical/vibe-coding-intro/): What "vibe coding" is, when it supercharges developer velocity, and where it fits in the software workflow.
- [Beyond the Prompt: Why Your Next AI Agent Needs a Brain (The COALA Architecture)](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/technical/coala-agent-brain-architecture/): Decomposing agent intelligence into modular memory, action spaces, and cognitive decision cycles.
- [Google Cloud GKE Tops 2025 Magic Quadrant](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/technical/gke-magic-quadrant/): Analysis of Google Kubernetes Engine leadership in enterprise container management.
- [DeepSeek API Service on Vertex AI Model Garden](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/technical/deepseek-vertex-ai-model-garden/): Deploying, securing, and querying DeepSeek models on Google Cloud Vertex AI infrastructure.
- [Unlocking the Secret Language of Sound: How Computers 'Hear' (for Python Devs!)](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/technical/secret-language-of-sound/): Audio signal processing fundamentals, Fourier transforms (FFT), and Mel-spectrograms for AI models.
- [Gemini Global Endpoint: Enhanced Availability for Your AI Applications](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/technical/gemini-global-endpoint/): High-availability routing and cross-region resilience with Vertex AI Gemini global endpoints.
- [Keep Your Git Clean: Setting Up a Global .gitignore](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/technical/global-gitignore-setup/): Universal workstation configuration to keep OS artifacts and IDE caches out of git repositories.
- [Podman Developer Notes: A Daemonless, Rootless Container Guide](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/technical/podman-developer-notes/): Using Podman as a secure, rootless Docker alternative with native Kubernetes Pod manifest support.
- [The Six Essential Protocols Powering the AI Agent Ecosystem](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/technical/six-essential-protocols/): Survey of A2A, MCP, and the other protocols that make agent-to-agent systems work.
- [Token Counting: What is it? Why is it required? How to use?](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/technical/token-counting-explained/): How language models tokenize text, why token counting prevents billing surprises, and SDK implementation.
- [Load Balancing Blitz: Google Cloud Load Balancing Introduction](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/technical/load-balancing-blitz-intro/): Overview of global vs regional, external vs internal application load balancing on Google Cloud.
- [Vibe Coding: Essential Dos, Don'ts and Guardrails](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/technical/vibe-coding-dos-donts/): Practical guardrails for shipping code with an AI pair.
- [What is Sharding, Partitioning and Why Sharding Managers?](https://msampathkumar.github.io/writing/technical/sharding-partitioning-sharding-managers/): Database scaling principles, horizontal sharding vs vertical partitioning, and shard manager proxy architectures.
